steps.en: Clone, run the setup script once, and put API keys in .env
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，跑一次安装脚本，把 API 密钥写进 .env

steps.en: Pick a task and a model and start the agent run
steps.zh: 选一道题和一个模型，启动 agent 运行

steps.en: Runs the tool loop over the case file in an offline Podman sandbox
steps.zh: 在断网的 Podman 沙箱里对案卷跑工具调用循环

steps.en: Saves deliverables, transcript and metrics under results/
steps.zh: 把交付物、对话记录和指标存进 results/

steps.en: Start grading for that run ID
steps.zh: 对这个运行 ID 发起评分

steps.en: Two LLM judges mark every criterion pass/fail and write report.html
steps.zh: 两个大模型评委逐条判通过与否，生成 report.html

value.en: An all-or-nothing score per legal task with per-criterion reasoning, instead of hand-checking every memo
value.zh: 每道法律题得到全对才算过的分数和逐条理由，不必再人工逐份核对备忘录

sources: docs/tutorial.md: Step 1 (setup.sh), Step 2 (.env keys), Step 4 (lab_core.harness.run), Step 6 (lab_core.evaluation.run_eval), Step 7 (report.html)

docs/eval-strategies.md: dual judges and all-pass scoring
